historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission upheld the preliminary negative declaration for the 150 Powell Street project.
The site held the 150 Powell Street building and three existing one-to-three-story buildings fronting on O'Farrell Street.

The City Planning Commission approved as amended the Section 309 determinations and exceptions to seismically upgrade and expand the existing four-story Category IV building, demolishing three smaller adjacent buildings on O'Farrell Street.
The City Planning Commission approved the office development limitation authorization for the seven-story building with up to 70,000 gross square feet of office space.
The City Planning Commission approved as amended the conditional use for office uses in the expanded building.
The City Planning Commission approved the permit to alter for major alterations to the Category IV building.
The City Planning Commission approved an 18-month extension of the time period for commencement of construction under the conditions of Planning Commission Motion 16117.
The City Planning Commission approved an 18-month extension of the time period for commencement of construction under the conditions of Planning Commission Motion 16118.
The City Planning Commission approved an 18-month extension of the time period for commencement of construction under the conditions of Planning Commission Motion 16119.

The City Planning Commission approved the Section 309 determination of compliance for an addition connected to the east side of the existing 150 Powell Street building and renovation of that building.
The City Planning Commission approved conditional-use authorization to allow up to 50 units of timeshare use in the addition and renovation project.
